passages.judgement: “Anki 问答卡片”是自然的中文名词短语，语序与卡片页标题“生成 Anki 问答卡片与 Cloze 填空卡片”一致，也与站内对 Basic 卡片的既有叫法一致（卡片页“问答（Basic）卡片”、CSV 指南“Basic 问答卡片”“选择问答卡片或填空卡片”、文档首页“创建问答和填空卡片”）。“卡片”仍按简报对应 card，没有把笔记说成卡片：本页唯一的示例 Note.basic('hola', 'hello') 生成一条 Basic 笔记和一张“hola → hello”问答卡片，描述的说法在事实上准确。这里不需要再括注 Basic：本页只出现一种卡片，括注只会造成名词堆叠。整句“从 PyPI 安装 ankiforge，用简短的 Python 脚本生成 Anki 问答卡片，并导出可导入 Anki 的 APKG 牌组。”三个动宾分句并列，节奏不变，共 69 字。作为搜索摘要，中文用户能直接读出包从哪里装、用什么写、生成哪种卡片、导出成什么。与标题“用 Python 生成 Anki 卡片”不矛盾：标题说任务，描述具体说明本页示例生成的卡片类型，没有声称 Python 只能生成问答卡片；填空、媒体、模板与图片遮挡仍在“继续学习”中链接。

languageJudgement.zh-CN: 新描述自然、准确，可以作为中文搜索摘要直接使用。“问答卡片”与卡片页标题、卡片页导语、CSV 指南和文档首页的叫法一致，也贴近中文 Anki 用户熟悉的“问答题”。它比旧描述多说明了卡片类型，而这正是本页唯一示例生成的内容（Note.basic → hola → hello），没有夸大功能，也没有把笔记和卡片混为一谈。与标题“用 Python 生成 Anki 卡片”是“任务 + 具体结果”的关系，不冲突。没有 critical、major 或 minor 问题，评分保持 5/5/5/5。

outOfScopeObservations: Sibling parallelism, not recorded as an issue: in the zh-CN quickstart list (e.g. website/dist/zh-cn/llms.txt lines 19-21) the Rust and Node.js descriptions say 卡片 while Python now says 问答卡片, although all three quickstarts build the same Basic note (hola → hello). Each description is accurate on its own and a reader is not misled. If the team later wants the three to read in parallel, the Node.js zh-CN description could say “用 Node.js 或 TypeScript 生成 Anki 问答卡片”. That would make node-quickstart/zh-CN stale, so it is only an optional follow-up and was not judged here.

The en description (“generate Anki flashcards with a short Python script”) is unchanged and does not name the card type. The zh-CN text is now slightly more specific than the English. The language brief rejects mechanical mirroring, so this is acceptable localization; the en record is not stale and was not re-judged.

The edit was made so the fixed query zh-CN-core-03 (“Python 问答 生成牌组”) would rank python-quickstart again. This review judges only the wording. The wording stands on its own: it describes what the page actually generates. Whether visible copy or website/search-terms.json is the better lever for ranking is a technical/search decision outside this review.
